title: botrychium multifidum var. intermedium
intro: Botrychium multifidum var. intermedium, commonly known as the intermediate rattlesnake fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antifungal properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of B. multifidum var. intermedium include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various phenolic compounds and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
